subject: Service interruption: bridge notes, customer executive update & follow-up plan
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Park <nina.park@softly.ai>, support@softly.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [SEV2] Brief — investigating increased error rate for SoftlyAI

Nina / Softly ops,

We detected an elevated error rate impacting inference requests for your account beginning ~08:50 PDT. Our SREs are on a bridge now and we have prioritized your traffic. This is currently classified SEV2 (impacting some requests with 5xx errors and timeouts).

Immediate asks:
- Softly: any recent config changes or large deployment windows we should be aware of?
- Redwood: we'll run a focused correlation against model variant, sequence length, and region routing.

I'll share an executive-facing status in 30–45 minutes and a technical snapshot shortly. Attaching an early logs export and a draft timeline (timeline-draft.pdf) for internal review.

Short signature.

-- 
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [SEV2] Brief — investigating increased error rate for SoftlyAI

On Sun, May 30, 2027 at 9:12 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We detected an elevated error rate impacting inference requests for your account beginning ~08:50 PDT.

Quick update from infra: CPU on the us-west inference pool spiked ~08:49 concurrent with a growth in short-sequence fanout. We're rolling a config change to limit concurrency per-tenant and pushing a lightweight patch to avoid a pathological KV-cache eviction pattern. Expected to reduce errors within 10–15 minutes after rollout. I'll post the canary results.

I'll also prepare a minimal customer-facing note for Nina that avoids deep technical detail.

- Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Park <nina.park@softly.ai>
Cc: support@softly.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Service update — SoftlyAI (impacting some requests)

Nina,

Quick executive update from Redwood:
- What happened: beginning ~08:50 PDT we observed increased 5xx errors for a subset of traffic routed to our us-west pool.
- What we're doing: we've deployed a targeted mitigation (concurrency limiter and KV-cache patch) and prioritized Softly requests.
- Current status: errors have dropped ~70% in the last 10 minutes; we continue monitoring.
- ETA: we expect full restoration across your workload within 30–60 minutes; we'll confirm when stable for 30m.

Immediate customer impact: some inference requests returned errors or timed out; no data was exposed and there is no indication of model corruption.

Next steps:
1) I'll follow up with a technical postmortem and timeline by EOD tomorrow.
2) We'll offer a credit for impacted tokens as appropriate; we'll confirm scope after the postmortem.

If you'd like a short call for exec-level context, I'm available within the hour.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service update — SoftlyAI — postmortem actions

Thanks — please see initial action tracker below. I've uploaded raw logs to Drive and pasted the short list of owners:
- Timeline & customer note (draft): Mateo (owner)
- Detailed incident timeline / correlation (infra): Laura (owner)
- Quantify impacted requests / token estimate (billing): Ben Carter (I'll loop him in)
- Remediation follow-through & SLA review: Vanessa

Attachments: service-logs-20270530.txt (internal/ops), link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/postmortem-softly-20270530

Please add comments directly to the timeline draft and flag any blockers. We'll schedule a 60-min postmortem tomorrow 11:00 PDT; calendar invite to follow.

- V

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Park <nina.park@softly.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, support@softly.ai
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Follow-up & postmortem invite — SoftlyAI incident

Hi Nina,

Thanks again for working with us yesterday. We restored stable service by ~09:15 PDT and have continued monitoring. We've scheduled a postmortem review for Tue, 11:00 PDT to walk through root cause, remediation, and any compensation.

High-level summary (preliminary):
- Cause: concurrency surge exposed a KV-cache eviction bug in the us-west serving runtime that caused elevated error rates for small-sequence fanouts.
- Action taken: hotfix applied to limit tenant concurrency and fix eviction path.
- Customer impact: intermittent 5xx/timeouts for ~25 minutes affecting ~2.8% of requests. No data leakage.

Agenda & materials: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/postmortem-softly-20270530
Invite: sent for Tue 11:00 PDT (email calendar). Please let me know if you prefer a different time.

We will provide a final postmortem (non-technical executive summary + appendix) within 48 hours.

Best regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
